notes.title: 🛠 Patch #3: UI Polishing, Bug Fixes & Tutorial Improvements
notes.content:
[b]Ping! This is Shi.[/b]  
Warden, patch 3 is now deployed. This update focuses on visual polish and system stability. Several key changes will significantly improve your field operations.

[b]📘 Tutorial & UX Improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*]Improved tutorial guidance for the [b]“Escape”[/b] mechanic: now includes clearer info and a prompt before action.
[*]After escaping a mission, the game will now auto-load from the most recent autosave to let you retry smoothly.  
[*]The “Skip Day” button is now highlighted in the tutorial after Mission 1-1.  
[*]Tutorial upgraded for better clarity on item management.  
[/list]
[b]🛠 Gameplay & Interface Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Double-squad missions now process correctly, no more missing second screen.  
[*]Effect icons now display correctly in skill tooltips.  
[*]UI buttons now reset properly when using the [b]Back[/b] option in settings.  
[*]Hover text for base modules reorganized for better clarity.  
[*]Combat system and HP logic slightly adjusted for improved story mode pacing.  
[*]Minor bug fixes, including resolving rare cursor disappearance issues.  
[/list]
[b]🌍 Localization Updates:[/b]
[list]
[*]Added Indonesian and Portuguese (AI-translated; subject to revision). If you want to help us with the translation into your language, please contact us via Steam discussions or Discord. 
[*]Survey links now correlate with your chosen language.  
[/list]
Play now and check it out! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1396540/Twilight_Wars
We’re deeply grateful for your support! We read everything and are always open to more suggestions.  
Keep sending signals, Warden.

[b]Join us on social media for more news and updates:[/b]
🤖 [url=https://discord.gg/6dgqyMCh6R]Discord[/url]
🤖 [url=https://x.com/ShiTripleA]Twitter/X[/url]
🤖 [url=https://bsky.app/profile/shitriplea.bsky.social]Bluesky[/url]

[b]See you at the “Triple-A” base.[/b]
– Shi

notes.title: 🛠 Patch #2 – Difficulty Adjustments & Quality of Life Improvements.
notes.content:
[b]Ping! This is Shi.[/b]  
Warden, field conditions evolve – and so must we. This update brings new tactical options for both seasoned operatives and those just entering the shadows.

[b]🟢 New Difficulty: “Easy” Mode[/b]  
A new difficulty setting has been added for players who wish to focus more on the story and atmosphere of Twilight Wars, without the pressure of brutal encounters.

[list]
[*]Agents have more health and deal increased damage.  
[*]The Agency starts with a larger amount of money, allowing you to [b]“skip days”[/b] more freely to recover agent health and morale.  
[*]Designed for a relaxed experience. Combat is still tactical, but the heat is turned down.  
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40261456/3ac178a0d51c24965093bebb7002be24fdee4266.png[/img]

[b]⚙️ Adjustments to “Recommended” Mode[/b]  
[list]
[*]Enemies no longer deal devastating critical hits.  
[*]Starting funds have been increased, making day-skipping for recovery more accessible.  
[/list]
[b]Please note:[/b] to access these changes, you’ll need to [b]start a new game[/b] and select the mode you wish to play in during the initial setup. It does not apply retroactively to existing save files.

[b]⏩ Additional Settings[/b]  
New speed-up options are now available to those who’ve made themselves familiar with the base, and really, really hate to wait:
[list]
[*]Combat animations  
[*]Message popups in the in-game messenger  
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40261456/d24eaca68224193fca09ed3882ec299e67a7ea35.jpg[/img]

These will be especially useful for Warden-level operatives who’ve already spent several hours in the field and wish to streamline the routine.

[b]🔧 Localization Fixes[/b]  
[list]
[*]A number of localization issues have been corrected based on community feedback.  
[/list]
Play now and check it out! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1396540/Twilight_Wars
Your feedback is critical to our mission.  
We read every message and every review, and your input is already shaping future updates.  
More improvements are planned, and we’ll share details with you soon.

[b]Join us on social media for more news and updates:[/b]
🤖 [url=https://discord.gg/6dgqyMCh6R]Discord[/url]
🤖 [url=https://x.com/ShiTripleA]Twitter/X[/url]
🤖 [url=https://bsky.app/profile/shitriplea.bsky.social]Bluesky[/url]

[b]See you at the “Triple-A” base.[/b]
– Shi

notes.title: 🛠 Patch #1 – New Mode Added: No More Misses!
notes.content:
[b]Ping! This is Shi.[/b]  
Warden, I’ve analyzed your field reports, and adjustments have been deployed.

[b]🟢 New Difficulty: “Recommended” Mode[/b]  
This new mode is ideal for players who prefer a more forgiving experience without sacrificing tactical depth.

[b]Key features of “Recommended” mode:[/b]

notes.title: Update Deployed: New Twilight Wars Playtest Version Now Live
notes.content:
[b]Ping, Warden.[/b]

Your feedback has been invaluable. We’ve read every report, studied every comment, and integrated your insights to make [i]Twilight Wars[/i] a better, sharper experience. The full release is near, but first, we’d love to share an update to our playtest build.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40261456/59e262c0f26b166b7e6170967b45e13b50495115.png[/img]

This version reflects your voice. We’ve adjusted mechanics, refined systems, and added features directly inspired by your input. Now, we need you again: dive in, test everything, break what you can — and then tell us all about it. Your insights are how this game evolves.

[b]Drop your thoughts in the in-game feedback form or on our Discord. Every message counts.[/b]

[b]How to Join the Playtest[/b]
Just head to our Steam page, click [b]“Request Access”[/b], and you’re in.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1396540/Twilight_Wars/

The feedback form opens automatically after you close the game. This only applies to the playtest build, as we need all the input we can get. It won’t be included in the final version!

[b]🧠 What’s New – Based on Your Feedback[/b]
[list]
[*]As requested, we made the in-game random events smarter – now you'll face less unfair outcomes!
[*]Steam Status Display
[*]Agent and Enemy Balance Tweaks
[*]Module and Upgrade Cost Adjustments
[*]Module Bonus Recalibration
[*]Energy System Rework
[*]Drone Overhaul: The Drone can now receive and apply buffs to your squad, its upgrades are rebalanced, and repair cost is reduced.
[*]Warden Skill Bonuses Refined
[*]Morale System Overhaul
[*]Wound System Tweaks
[*]Psycho Perk Behavior Changes
[*]Reworked Tutorial
[*]Skip Buttons for Cinematics and Loading Screens
[*]Improved Combat and Group Chat Logs
[*]Cosmetic Updates
[*]Bug Fixes & Minor Optimizations
[/list]
[b]Note:[/b] We want to let you know that your saves from a previous version of the build [i]might not carry over[/i] to this one. Thank you for your patience and continued support as we keep refining the game.

This build is not just a test — it’s a milestone. And your continued support is what powers this Agency forward. [b]We’re counting on your voice! Let us know what works, what doesn’t, and what still needs to be cracked.[/b] 

[b]Share your thoughts with us, it’s the intel we rely on.[/b] 
[b]Join us on social media for more news and updates![/b]  
🤖 [url=https://discord.gg/6dgqyMCh6R]Discord[/url]  
🤖 [url=https://twitter.com/ShiTripleA]Twitter/X[/url]  
🤖 [url=https://bsky.app/profile/shitriplea.bsky.social]Bluesky[/url]  
[b]Your analysis is vital.[/b]  
[i]See you at the “Triple-A” base![/i]

notes.title: 🔐 Access Granted: Twilight Wars Playtest Is Now Live
notes.content:
Ping, Warden. 

The new Playtest build of Twilight Wars is now available on Steam. I have ensured it includes all recent operational changes. You are invited to join the simulation, assess performance, and report anomalies.

If this is your first activation: welcome. The current build will allow you to understand the tactical structure, experience the world, and evaluate your compatibility with the mission. If you are returning: expect system-level changes. 

This marks a critical milestone in Twilight Wars development. The systems you are about to engage with closely reflect those intended for the full release. [b]Your feedback at this stage is not only welcome - it is essential.[/b]

[b]We require your insights to validate core mechanics, balance, and experience flow. Every report brings us closer to operational readiness.[/b] Proceed with care. Report thoroughly.

[h2]How to Join the Playtest[/h2]
It’s super simple – just two clicks!
Visit the Twilight Wars Steam Page, click “Request Access”, and you’re in.
Play, explore, break things. Report bugs. Drop your feedback through the in-game form or on our Discord channel.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40261456/734d64ab6de78f0da3f9e612ae14be70599d221e.png[/img]

[b]Below is a comprehensive summary of all modifications introduced in this Playtest build, as well as key deviations from the previous demo version. Proceed with analysis.[/b]

[h3]🆕 New Features in the Playtest:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Easy & Hardcore Difficulty Modes. Easy lets you replay missions and fights - ideal for exploring the lore. Hardcore? One shot, no do-overs.
[*] New Unique Agent: The Drone
[*] New Base Module: The Workshop
[*] Soundtrack Library: Listen to unlocked music tracks from your base.
[*] Day Skip Option: Take a break between missions.
[*] New Codex: Detailed explanations of all core mechanics.
[*] Psycho Perk System Improvements: Deeper growth options and new behaviors.
[*] Health, Defense & Evasion indicators above characters during combat.
[*] Game Over on Negative Balance: Don’t let your agency go bankrupt!
[*] Agent Salary Requests now matter: Ignore them and face the consequences.
[*] New In-Combat Help Screen: Press "H" to get quick info during battles.
[*] Hotkeys: Use items and abilities faster and smoother in combat.
[*] Localization update: We've heard your feedback! Twilight Wars is now available in German, French, Italian, Spanish, Russian and Turkish
[/list]
[h3]🔧 Fixes & Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] Tutorial Overhaul & Smarter AI: Enemies are now deadlier and more strategic.
[*] Faster Combat: Rebalanced stats speed up mission tempo.
[*] Save System Overhaul: Along with improved perks, recon, squad strength formula, and status effects.
[*] Messenger Upgrades: Reactions, notifications, and message history added.
[*] Base Stability Improved: Better module functionality and mission logic.
[*] Unbalanced Skills Removed/Reworked + major bug fixes.
[*] UI now scales properly at all resolutions.
[/list]
[h3]🎨 Visual & UX Updates[/h3]
[list]
[*] Full Redesign of Main Menu and Settings screens.
[*] Visual Effects Overhaul: Morale, loyalty, resurrection, notifications.
[*] New Combat Animations & Boss Versus Screens
[*] Scripted Scenes Added
[*] Mission Map Improvements: Animated guides now make navigation easier.
[*] Tooltip Clarity Boosted
[*] Updated Maps, Loading Screens & Agent Loyalty Interface
[*] New Status Effects: “Caught Off Guard,” “Healing Blocked,” and more.
[/list]
[h3]About Twilight wars[/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1396540/Twilight_Wars/ 
Twilight Wars is a dungeon crawler in a cyberpunk setting, where corporations fight for resources and influence. You will have to revive a secret organization, recruit top-class specialists and restore the balance of power in the world!

[b]Join us on social media for more news and updates! [/b]
🤖Discord: https://discord.gg/6dgqyMCh6R 
🤖Twitter/X: https://twitter.com/ShiTripleA

🤖Bluesky: https://bsky.app/profile/shitriplea.bsky.social 

Your analysis is vital.
See you at the “Triple-A” base!
- Shi

notes.title: Happy New Year, Agents! Here’s our 2024 recap!
notes.content:
🤖 *Ping!* This is Shi, your AI companion, with an exciting update on our progress this year and plans for the future. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40261456/8116a6ba7ff5df89997c03b616e47b8637ce38e7.png[/img]

Let’s recap 2024’s achievements and look ahead to our mission goals!

[h3]2024 Highlights[/h3]

[b]Fully Playable Build[/b]  
We reached a major milestone: the game is now 90% complete, with all endings implemented and the gameplay loop ready for fine-tuning.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40261456/70ea33c44bd5cebf127131713b4be4ddb3e55f70.gif[/img]

[b]Content Completion[/b]  
The narrative, art, animations, and music are nearly finalized, ensuring a deep, immersive experience.

[b]Showcase Triumphs[/b]  
We dedicated a lot of time to game showcases and even snagged a Players’ Choice Award! Your feedback during these events helped us refine tutorials, mechanics, and design.

[b]Gameplay Overhaul[/b]  
Expect new combat mechanics, a new character and module, and a rebalanced system for battles and maps.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40261456/ce520b5ecf4fdea0d5ddef47a3541cc7ee723857.gif[/img]

[b]New Art & Animations[/b]  
There’s a treasure trove of unseen content we can’t wait to reveal in the lead-up to release. Get ready for even more stunning visuals and fluid animations!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40261456/45e34006350e0c0f0e3e8ba30f0d67c7f1b79b79.gif[/img]

[b]Team Expansion[/b]  
We welcomed new people to the team, who’ll help us with game design, narrative writing, localization, and community management.

[h3]Challenges and Victories [/h3]

[b]Optimization Battle[/b]  
We faced (and conquered!) challenges in performance optimization, ensuring the game runs smoothly on a variety of systems.

[b]Tutorial Iterations[/b]  
After multiple tests, the tutorial is now polished and intuitive, thanks to invaluable player insights.

[b]Player-Centric Refinements[/b]  
Your feedback has driven key changes, from narrative tweaks to balancing mechanics. Together, we’re building a game worth waiting for.

[h3]Looking Ahead: 2025[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40261456/94b2b6f6247d365f39becc66917a9ed1e9f5f84d.gif[/img]

[list]
[*] [b]Global Release:[/b] Q1 2025 is our target.  
[*] [b]Last-Stage Refinement:[/b] We're crushing bugs and fine-tuning balance to deliver the perfect launch version.
[*] [b]Community Connection:[/b] Your support on Steam, Discord, and social media continues to fuel our progress.  
[/list]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1396540/Twilight_Wars/ 

[b]About the game[/b]

Twilight Wars is a dungeon crawler in a cyberpunk setting, where corporations fight for resources and influence. You will have to revive a secret organization, recruit top-class specialists, and restore the balance of power in the world!

💻 Join our Discord: https://discord.com/invite/efCZEWsVgT 
💻 Follow us on X/Twitter: https://twitter.com/ShiTripleA 
💻 Read the news on Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/ComradeBearGames/ 

See you at the "Triple-A" base!

notes.title: Global Update of the Twilight Wars Demo!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40261456/a53f32261a86d17bac50731c578e05148257f514.png[/img]
Ping! This is Shi, the AI speaking. Since the release of the previous demo, many changes have occurred at the agency, and the reason for them is you — our Wardens, and your invaluable feedback: reviews, forum discussions, and survey results.

These innovations will fully unfold in the release version of the game, which is in active development, but you can already check out our progress by playing the updated Declassified 2.1 demo during the [b]Steam Turn-Based RPG Fest[/b].

Play now! Download the demo from the Twilight Wars game page using the "Download demo" button!

Here's a report so you don't miss anything interesting:

[h3][Tutorial][/h3]
[list]
[*] The tutorial for the missions and the Base has been updated. It now provides clearer and more detailed explanations of the game's core mechanics.
[*] Loading screens with tactical tips have been added to teach you various gameplay intricacies.
[/list]
[h3][Visuals][/h3]
[list]
[*] Improved status effect animations on characters, such as burning, poisoning, stunning, and more.
[*] Added animations on the screen during status effects to enhance the combat dynamics.
[*] Added various color schemes for enemies.
[*] Character death animations have been updated.
[*] The Region Map has been improved.
[/list]
[h3][Interface][/h3]
[list]
[*] Tooltips for abilities and characters have been refined. They are now more informative, with dynamic parameters and concise descriptions.
[*] Improved targeting reticles. Now, when selecting a target, information about the expected damage, status effects, and their effectiveness is displayed.
[*] Due to popular demand, fonts are now LARGER.
[/list]
[h3][Combat System][/h3]
[list]
[*] A detailed combat log has been added, making it easier to follow what's happening during missions. The log includes not only characters' actions and abilities but also key plot dialogues.
[*] A positive effect has been added when agents change positions, depending on their role.
[*] Enemy AI has been improved. They will now push you to adapt to combat situations and think through tactics more carefully.
[*] The Psychoperks system has been implemented — psychological traits of agents that provide penalties, bonuses, or more unusual and ambiguous effects.
[*] A new consumable item, the Neurotonic, has been added. It helps maintain agents' mental health. High morale not only makes them more accurate, agile, and loyal but also increases the chance of gaining a useful psychoperk.
[*] The Injury System has been implemented. When retreating or after completing a mission, agents can now sustain injuries. These come in varying severity, affecting the maximum health pool and can be treated in the updated Infirmary module.
[*] The Worldviews and Relationships system has been implemented, directly impacting the effectiveness of your squad. Agents with friendly relations will go on missions with high morale, while those with conflicting worldviews will suffer. You’ll feel the full pain of clashing worldviews during the first mission with the Kunoichi agent.
[*] Some enemies now have resistances to effects. For example, the gas mask-wearing rat is now resistant to poison.
[/list]
[h3][Balance][/h3]
[list]
[*] Many character abilities and the leveling system have been reworked. We have meticulously balanced the difficulty, and we hope that creating your own squad combinations and battling will be even more exciting!
[*] Adjusted consumable prices, mission rewards, and agent salaries.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40261456/a858de18a6b59583563da42d33397c56da88837c.gif[/img]
[h3][ Sound Design ][/h3]
[list]
[*] The combat and base music themes have been changed. Combat music is now more dynamic, while the base music is more relaxing. A variety of original soundtracks have been composed, which we hope will help immerse you in the cozy cyberpunk atmosphere.
[*] Improved battle sounds, such as "pain screams" when agents or enemies get hit. These screams were recorded by our team members, as well as our friends and family.
[*] The Radiostalker text quest has been refined.
[/list]
[h3][Base][/h3]
[list]
[*] You can now dismiss agents who, in your opinion, are not suited for working with "Triple-A." But use this extreme measure with caution — each character has a unique quest and personal dialogues that will become unavailable after dismissal.
[*] A "Biography" tab has been added to the agent profiles, where you can read the backstory of your favorite hero, better understand their personality, and motivations in the fight against corporations. Over time, new details will be added, revealing aspects of the character’s past or their development throughout the story.
[*] News has been added, reflecting the impact of your actions on the world. But don’t think everything revolves around "Triple-A" — the news will also cover events happening around the globe, independent of your involvement.
[*] A Group Chat has been added to the Messenger with agent comments and a detailed mission report, as well as base events such as module construction, changes in agent loyalty and morale, level-ups, psychoperks, and much more — perfect for those who focus more on the tactical aspect.
[*] In the demo, you will now have the opportunity to build a Columbarium — a module that allows you to resurrect a fallen agent using a digitized copy of their personality.
[*] The Relationship system between agents and the Watcher has been implemented. If agents' views differ from yours, they will receive the "Antagonism" psychoperk, and their loyalty to the organization will decrease.
[*] A music player has been added. The collection will grow as you progress through the game, but to gather all the tracks, you'll need to explore the map thoroughly during missions.
[/list]
[h3][Narrative][/h3]
[list]
[*] The demo now includes a new interview and private dialogue with agent Needle, which serves as a request for a personal mission.
[*] A new cutscene has been added and voiced, telling the story of corporate liberation and the rise of "Triple-A" as the sole opposing force.
[*] Text-based character reactions have been added to emphasize their personalities. In combat, they will comment on successful or failed shots, the death of enemies or allies, and more. At the base, they will share their opinions on various events, from module installations to hiring new staff.
[*] The narrative scene in the tutorial mission has been improved.
[/list]
[h3][Miscellaneous][/h3]
[list]
[*] Localization system reworked.
[*] Game graphics settings have been reworked.
[*] Numerous bugs and glitches have been fixed.
[*] Game resources have been optimized for faster load times.
[/list]

Thank you for supporting us, and please continue to share your thoughts through the in-game survey, available in the main menu, to help us improve.

See you at the "Triple-A" base!

Enemy AI has been improved. They will now push you to adapt to combat situations and think through tactics more carefully.
The Psychoperks system has been implemented — psychological traits of agents that provide penalties, bonuses, or more unusual and ambiguous effects.

A new consumable item, the Neurotonic, has been added. It helps maintain agents' mental health. High morale not only makes them more accurate, agile, and loyal but also increases the chance of gaining a useful psychoperk.

The Injury System has been implemented. When retreating or after completing a mission, agents can now sustain injuries. These come in varying severity, affecting the maximum health pool and can be treated in the updated Infirmary module.

The Worldviews and Relationships system has been implemented, directly impacting the effectiveness of your squad. Agents with friendly relations will go on missions with high morale, while those with conflicting worldviews will suffer. You’ll feel the full pain of clashing worldviews during the first mission with the Kunoichi agent.
Some enemies now have resistances to effects. For example, the gas mask-wearing rat is now resistant to poison.

tags.balance_change: Many character abilities and the leveling system have been reworked. We have meticulously balanced the difficulty, and we hope that creating your own squad combinations and battling will be even more exciting!
Adjusted consumable prices, mission rewards, and agent salaries.

tags.feature: The combat and base music themes have been changed. Combat music is now more dynamic, while the base music is more relaxing. A variety of original soundtracks have been composed, which we hope will help immerse you in the cozy cyberpunk atmosphere.
Improved battle sounds, such as "pain screams" when agents or enemies get hit. These screams were recorded by our team members, as well as our friends and family.
The Radiostalker text quest has been refined.

You can now dismiss agents who, in your opinion, are not suited for working with "Triple-A." But use this extreme measure with caution — each character has a unique quest and personal dialogues that will become unavailable after dismissal.

A "Biography" tab has been added to the agent profiles, where you can read the backstory of your favorite hero, better understand their personality, and motivations in the fight against corporations. Over time, new details will be added, revealing aspects of the character’s past or their development throughout the story.

News has been added, reflecting the impact of your actions on the world. But don’t think everything revolves around "Triple-A" — the news will also cover events happening around the globe, independent of your involvement.

A Group Chat has been added to the Messenger with agent comments and a detailed mission report, as well as base events such as module construction, changes in agent loyalty and morale, level-ups, psychoperks, and much more — perfect for those who focus more on the tactical aspect.
In the demo, you will now have the opportunity to build a Columbarium — a module that allows you to resurrect a fallen agent using a digitized copy of their personality.

The Relationship system between agents and the Watcher has been implemented. If agents' views differ from yours, they will receive the "Antagonism" psychoperk, and their loyalty to the organization will decrease.
A music player has been added. The collection will grow as you progress through the game, but to gather all the tracks, you'll need to explore the map thoroughly during missions.
The demo now includes a new interview and private dialogue with agent Needle, which serves as a request for a personal mission.
A new cutscene has been added and voiced, telling the story of corporate liberation and the rise of "Triple-A" as the sole opposing force.

Text-based character reactions have been added to emphasize their personalities. In combat, they will comment on successful or failed shots, the death of enemies or allies, and more. At the base, they will share their opinions on various events, from module installations to hiring new staff.
The narrative scene in the tutorial mission has been improved.
Localization system reworked.
Game graphics settings have been reworked.

tags.bug: Numerous bugs and glitches have been fixed.

tags.feature: Game resources have been optimized for faster load times.

notes.title: Features of the Twilight Wars game genre
notes.content:
Comrades,

Since Twilight Wars: Declassified 2.0 was released, you have been actively sharing your ideas and giving your feedback. Our team has thoroughly examined the feedback and recognized the importance of providing a detailed explanation of certain aspects of the game.

Before we dive in, it's worthwhile to delve into the game's genre to better understand it. In modern projects, it can often be quite challenging to identify a specific genre, as they frequently combine different mechanics and elements.

Twilight Wars is a dungeon crawler, turn-based strategy game with roguelite elements.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40261456/bbd5ad8378b0211451e658aa734fec3914e18d54.gif[/img]

[b][h3]Why this genre?[/h3][/b]
At the initial stage of the project’s development, it was clear that the dungeon crawler genre was the best fit. The concept of exploring and clearing labyrinthine dungeons in our case helps to better showcase the gameplay and narrative aspects. The actions unfold in various settings such as streets, laboratories, offices, and more, thereby immersing you even deeper into the game’s atmosphere.

[b][h3]Nuances of the combat system[/h3][/b]
The combat system in Twilight Wars, like in other turn-based strategy games, is based on the principle that the main focus is on the strict sequence of actions. Certain decisions made by the player during missions or dialogues with agents and Shi directly influence the further development of the plot.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40261456/f1e125a525ec9c54552ad8f3118a86936fc4bc6e.gif[/img]

The choice of agents for each mission can either make it easier or cause plenty of problems. And it’s not just about making a wrong choice based on the characters’ skills and abilities, they may also have quite strained relations with each other. We will give you more details about this in one of the upcoming devlogs about the ‘Living Agents’ system.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40261456/aea04836a416a476141741036486af49093da525.gif[/img]

[b][h3]Agents lost forever?[/h3][/b]
Probably many players are familiar with the situation of losing a beloved character without a possibility to revive them, which is always unpleasant. In the Twilight Wars project, all the agents are unique and… mortal. Therefore, one must approach the decision-making process as seriously as possible.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40261456/11e40dabb7131ea60b1b0c106b5190fa0dd1ada8.gif[/img]

We have analyzed player feedback and have decided to make it possible to revive agents, but with a few conditions. We will also tell you more in the upcoming devlogs.

[b][h3]Is it only about battles?[/h3][/b]
Exploring different locations and engaging in battles in the game is truly exciting. But there's more to our project's gameplay: developing the Triple-A base and constructing additional modules for various purposes, such as rest and healing for your agents. These modules allow agents to restore their mental and physical states after fighting enemies.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40261456/652f41212e6af40ed9767863b4598bd263297438.gif[/img]

As we continue to develop the project and gather player feedback, we constantly come up with new ideas to diversify the experience!

[b][h3]Be sure to add the game to your wishlist:[/h3][/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1396540/Twilight_Wars/

[h3]Free demo version Twilight Wars: Declassified 2.0 is available on Steam. Play it and share your feedback in the survey after completing the game![/h3]

notes.title: Twilight Wars: Declassified 2.0 is now available on Steam!
notes.content:
Comrades,

Our team is pleased to present you with [b]the long-awaited demo of Twilight Wars: Declassified 2.0[/b], which will immerse you in the atmosphere of cyberpunk espionage.

We have regularly shared the progress of the project with you on our social networks, receiving your reactions, feedback, and advice. Your feedback has been a great source of motivation for us, helping us understand what needed to be fixed and how to diversify the gameplay.

Now, it's time to share the results of our joint work at one of the most significant events for both players and developers - the October festival 'Steam Next Fest'!

You will get a glimpse of how the project has evolved since the release of the previous version of Twilight Wars: Declassified. The game now features new characters, exciting locations, vivid animations, and epic music. We have also made improvements to the character interaction system and the dialogue in the game. But we're not stopping here; there are many other ways we plan to improve and optimize the project!

[h3]Mission Plot Description:[/h3]

During the attack on the agency, Shi establishes contact with the sole surviving squad - Mentor, Needle, Handler, and Bomber. Following the AI's instructions, Mentor cancels the mission and leads the squad to a new secure location. However, the situation spirals out of control as they lose connection with the base, forcing the squad to navigate on their own. Numerous obstacles lie ahead as they strive to reach the new base and acquire information about Shi's further plans.

Prepare to embark on a captivating adventure set in the world of cyberpunk espionage. Engage in communication with artificial intelligence, experience enhanced gameplay mechanics, and immerse yourself in a thrilling storyline.

Join us at October's 'Steam Next Fest' event and be among the first to experience all that Twilight Wars: Declassified 2.0 demo has to offer.

[h3]We look forward to your feedback and hope you enjoy the demo![/h3]
